messages:
jamie (partnerships): Heads up — Saturn Systems (SI) will start sending daily usage webhooks for HW devices to /integrations/marketplace/usage. Need schema, idempotency, timezone handling, and entitlements mapping. cc @lara @alex

lara (eng-partner): Can you ask them for a sample payload? Also we need signing header and retry policy documented.

marco (Saturn SI): sample payload below — we'll POST daily for each device cluster, timezone is UTC but timestamp is local_ts when device reported. we'll include idempotency_token.
```json
{
  "device_id": "saturn-7a2",
  "customer_external_id": "acct_98765",
  "sku": "HW-PREM-8GPU",
  "units": 12,
  "usage_window_start": "2026-02-28T00:00:00-05:00",
  "usage_window_end": "2026-02-28T23:59:59-05:00",
  "reported_at_utc": "2026-02-29T04:00:12Z",
  "idempotency_token": "evt_20260229_0001",
  "sequence_per_device": 1234
}
```

alex (finance): For billing we need a canonical timezone for cutoff. We prefer UTC day boundaries. If they send local windows we must normalize to UTC. Also what's the reconciliation SLA? we need daily ingest + 14-day backfill window for corrections.

infra-bot: Delivery requirements: POST /v1/marketplace/usage -> respond 200 within 10s. Accepts JSON. HMAC header: X-Saturn-Signature:sha256=<sig>. Retries: exponential backoff, max 6 attempts. Duplicate detection: use idempotency_token + device_id + reported_at_utc.

lara (eng-partner): On SKU -> entitlement mapping: please provide a mapping CSV like \"saturn_sku,redwood_plan_id,unit_type\". We'll need unit_type (tokens/hours/units) and conversion factor if any.

billing-team (ops): For monthly invoicing we need per-event units, event timestamp (UTC), external_customer_id, resolved_redwood_plan_id, and the raw sku. Also request they include invoice_reference when they replay corrections.

jamie (partnerships): Marco — can you confirm sequence_per_device is monotonic and that corrections will reuse same idempotency_token but with correction=true flag?

marco (Saturn SI): yes to monotonic. corrections will set \"correction\": true and include original idempotency_token. We'll send invoice_reference for any backdated rectifications.

lara (eng-partner): Great. Action items: (1) Marco to send full SKU->plan mapping CSV, (2) Saturn to add HMAC docs and public key, (3) Infra to publish endpoint contract and test harness. I'll own validation tests. :thumbsup: 

jamie (partnerships): thanks all — I'll schedule a 30m sync with Saturn + infra + billing tomorrow 10am PT. Agenda: schema final, idempotency, and recon window. :calendar:
